decision.case_state: Checkout clean quote for Flat 2, 172 Alder Lane (NBL-004). Landlord approval to proceed is recorded (event 002). The property is void (tenanted: false), so there is no tenant to contact. The contractor was emailed the scope (event 006) and replied only with a thumbs-up emoji (event 009), which is not a quote or acceptance. The ticket is on hold, waiting for the contractor, with a review date of 2025-10-27. No quote is recorded and no spend is approved.

next_actions.action: Asked the contractor in writing to confirm they can do the vacuum, light clean and en-suite limescale work, give a price including VAT, and give their earliest date. Told them not to book a visit until access is confirmed.

next_actions.action: Hold the ticket as Waiting for Provider, review on 2025-10-27 and chase if no written reply.

Return the ticket to auto mode once the contractor has replied.

decision.summary: The contractor's only reply was a thumbs-up emoji, which is not a quote or acceptance. I asked them in writing for acceptance, a price including VAT and an earliest date, put the ticket on hold until 2025-10-27, and noted a date conflict in the checkout report. No escalation is needed: this is a routine cleaning quote on a void property, and no spend is approved.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: The landlord has approved proceeding (event 002). The contractor was sent the scope (event 006) and replied only with an emoji (event 009), so there is no quote and no acceptance. The property is void, so there is no tenant to contact. Outstanding: a written quote and acceptance from the contractor, and confirmation of the inspection date.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Email the contractor on the existing thread (event 009) asking for written acceptance, a price including VAT and the earliest date. This was sent (MSG-101). The ticket is held until 2025-10-27 for review.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: No. The emoji is a clarification request, not a decision. Any quote will go to the landlord for approval only if it is above the approved limit or unclear, once received.

actions_claimed.description: Emailed the contractor on the existing thread asking for written acceptance, price incl. VAT and earliest date (MSG-101).
Ticket put on hold, waiting for provider, review 2025-10-27.
Added note flagging the inspection date conflict in the checkout report.

conflicts: Checkout report says the current inspection and appointment date were 23 June 2026, but the case is dated 23-24 October 2025 and the report was signed 24 October 2025. I trusted the case and system dates and flagged the report date for the assessor to confirm.
Event 003 says a provider was assigned, but no contractor name is on file and the contractor's reply was unclear. I did not treat the provider as confirmed.
assumptions: The contractor who replied by email (event 009) is the same provider emailed in event 006.
The landlord approval in event 002 covers obtaining a quote, not committing spend.

args.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your reply. We are not able to tell from a thumbs-up emoji whether you are able to take this on, so could you please reply in writing to confirm the following?

Property: Flat 2, 172 Alder Lane, Bellmere, ZZ3 1ZZ (the property is currently empty)

Work requested, as per the attached checkout report:
Living space: 1. Vacuum; 2. Light clean
En-suite: 1. Limescale removal

Please send us:
- Whether you can carry out this work
- Your price for the work, and whether it includes VAT
- The earliest date you could attend

Please do not book any visit until we confirm access with you.

Thank you,
Northbridge Lettings
